steps.title: Sketch and extrude the section
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as heel_post.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the ground). Circle diameter 450 on the origin (the pivot axis). Rectangle from the centre, 400 along X and 450 wide (225 each side). Finish Sketch.
Extrude both regions 5800 mm up, with a 50 mm start offset (Advanced), so the post runs from 50 to 5850.
steps.note: The origin of this part is the pivot axis: every other part of the leaf is placed from it.

steps.title: Make it hollow
actions: Work Features panel > Plane > Offset from Plane: 5825 mm above the XZ Plane. Sketch on it.
Project the outline (Sketch tab > Project Geometry) and Offset it 25 mm inwards: 25 mm plate.
Extrude the inner region, Cut, 5475 mm downwards. Click OK.
steps.note: The bottom 300 mm stays solid: the bearing block that sits on the pintle.

steps.title: Bore for the pintle bush
actions: Click Hole. Placement: the bottom face, on the pivot axis.
Simple Hole, diameter 190 mm, Distance 250 mm. Click OK.
steps.note: The bronze pintle bush is pressed into this bore.

steps.title: Top journal
actions: Sketch on the top face: circle diameter 200 on the pivot axis. Extrude 150 mm up. Click OK.
Material: Steel S355 (Manage tab > Styles Editor if it is not in your library). Save.
steps.note: The anchor collar and its bush fit round this journal: the top hinge.
